notes.title: Full Release on Steam – Thank You, Champions!
notes.notes:
Hey there, incredible Champions of Grapple Tournament!

We're beyond thrilled to share this monumental moment with you – Grapple Tournament is officially transitioning from Early Access to its full release on Steam! 🎮✨ This is the culmination of the dream we've had from the very beginning, and we couldn't be happier to reach this milestone with your support. Thank you, our beloved Champions, from the bottom of our hearts! 🙌

A Look Back at the Early Access Journey

Early Access has been an incredible adventure, filled with ups, downs, and everything in between. Watching the Grapple Tournament community grow, hearing your stories, and getting your feedback and implementing them in-game has been an amazing experience. You've helped us shape Grapple Tournament into something we're immensely proud of, and we can't thank you enough for that. 😊

From EA to Free-to-Play to Full Steam Ahead

Three months ago, we made a game-changing decision – we went free-to-play. It's been an exciting journey since then, and we're thrilled to see a steady stream of Champions joining the community every day. Your enthusiasm and support have been incredible, and we're truly grateful for it.

What Awaits in the Future

Now, let's talk about what's next because the things are just starting! We've got big plans for the future of Grapple Tournament, and here's a sneak peek:

1. Enhanced Gameplay: Get ready for an even more immersive gaming experience! We're working on game balance based on your feedback to create challenge and fun for everyone.

2. Fresh Content: Brace yourselves for new adventures! We'll be regularly adding fresh content, including new guns, maps, modes and other exciting features to keep you coming back for more.

3. Quality Assurance: Our commitment to delivering a top-notch gaming experience remains steadfast. We'll continue to polish and refine Grapple Tournament, addressing bugs and issues to ensure a fluid experience.

A Heartfelt Thank You

Before we get too carried away with excitement about what lies ahead, we want to take a moment to express our deepest gratitude. Your unwavering support has made this journey possible, and your passion fuels our drive to make Grapple Tournament the best it can be. 🌟

Reaching the full release has always been our dream, and we're ecstatic to have made it a reality, hand in hand with you, Champions. So, once again, thank you for being part of this incredible journey! 🙏

Join Us in Celebrating and Share Your Favorite Moment!

We'd like to hear from you!

Share your favorite moments from Grapple Tournament with the community here or on Discord or on your chosen social channel. Your stories and experiences are what make this community so special, so let's relive those epic moments together! 🎮📣

And if you've been playing the game, here's a humble request: we'd greatly appreciate it if you could leave an honest review on Steam about Grapple Tournament. Your reviews help others discover the game and our community. 🌟

Stay tuned, stay awesome, and happy gaming, Champions! 🎮✨

We can't wait to continue this incredible journey with you all.

With love and gratitude,
Grapple Tournament Team

notes.title: Update 35: Grapple Tournament is now Free-To-Play!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Champions!

The day has finally come!
We are thrilled to announce that Grapple Tournament is now officially Free-To-Play!

Since we started the transition phase to Free-To-Play, we've been seeing steadily growing interest for the game. New members are joining the community every day and are sending us valuable feedback on what to improve in the game. This makes us happier than ever!

The changes of the previous update were greeted cheerfully and with this Update 35 release, we are already bringing some newly requested features!

New:
- Added deadzone settings separately for the left and right joysticks
- Opened Daily offers available for all platforms
- Credit Store made available on the Meta Quest version (work in progress on Steam)
- Added higher smooth turn speed levels

Improvements and changes:
- In the options, turning the HUD on/off will change the health and shield displays accordingly
- Changed glass visuals on Spiral to improve level design visibility
- Changed the Railgun secondary projectile graphics to increase visibility on Meta Quests

Fixes:
- Fixed some graphics issues on Spiral

What's next?
- The demo on Steam is sunsetting
- Credit store on Steam
- Preview for items in the daily shop
- Season 1 starts very soon!

notes.title: Update 33: The first step towards Free-To-Play!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Champions!

We are thrilled to bring you Grapple Tournament Update 33 - the first step towards Free-To-Play!

This is the first transition build on the road to making the game free!
Read more about this here.

Before we start the update log, please note that if you have the full version of the game, 
log in at least once to get your CREDITS before the transition ends!

New:
- Reworked and extended the customization system
-- Redesigned the system for wearables
-- Added Armor Skin customizations, glove skin matches body skin
-- Added Grappling Hook and Cable customizations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38599330/7d2252b3767162868c2728808d37abcbcf0024a6.png

-- Added Weapon Skins to the system, with a tons of new skins on the way
- Customization items have two background colors:
-- Blue: available in the shop
-- Purple: coming later to the shop, or in a battle pass, or some other way, or timed exclusive
- Introducing CREDIT(s) as the new ingame currency
-- You can earn CREDITs with buying the currency in the CREDIT Store
-- Soon we'll add more ways to earn CREDITS via playing the game and completing challenges
- Added CREDIT Store
-- currently only on Meta platforms
-- work in progress for Steam
- Added Daily shop for the paid version (coming soon to the free version)
-- Offering 5 purchasable items every day
-- With Reroll functionality to refresh the selection of daily offers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38599330/8500082f019642632ee6c490506d56889ceac8ef.png

- New pause menu graphics design
- Added Armory in the entry HUB area to show you current loadout
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38599330/35e025b6bea24d0b9ec9394bef52427e7bcc4aec.png
Changes:
- Changed the UI in some places for better readability
- Added randomized customizations for bots
- Refined enemy coloring to look better close-up
- Complex got it's final art pass

Optimizations:
- Optimized complex UI windows in the game for performance improvements
- Removed drone customizations to gain performance in the Drone Challenge
- Removed menu coloring option to save on performance on all UI elements
- Removed some unused assets and codes from the build to save disk space

Fixes:
- Fixed weapon setup when gripping weapon on spawn (in Instagib)
- Fixed jump sound when using grappling hook after double jump
- Fixed a bug about FFA HUD not updating at game start
- Fixed spawn locations and colliders on Icebreaker
- Fixed typos in some places on UI
- Fixed a bug that showed other players' menu laser pointers

In this update, we've made significant enhancements to the underlying systems and as with any major revamp, there's potential for a few hiccups. We appreciate your patience and feedback as we fine-tune everything!

Work-in-progress and known issues:
- New UI design is not final
- Some customization item icons are not final
- Working on a preview for items in the shop
- Working on the CREDIT store functionality on Steam
- Some non-English translations might be missing
- In the weapons list you've probably noticed the new weapon, that is coming soon ;)

What's next:
We are continuing the transition to free to play in priority.

Communications and marketing around the game being available for everyone is starting. As always we'll listen to the community and will consider your feedback.

notes.title: Update 29: Judgement for Instagib - The biggest update so far
notes.notes:
Greetings, champions!

Update 29 this winter is the biggest update so far in the history of Grapple Tournament. We tried our best to squeeze in as many new features as we could possibly do, all of which you asked for.

New:
- Game engine updated to Unreal Engine 4.27 under the hood
- Added new game mode: Instagib
-- A Deathmatch variant where players can instantly kill their opponents with the new weapon
- Added new weapon: Judgement
-- Instantly kills target on hit (primary fire)
-- Can penetrate through multiple targets
-- Hellish headshot damage

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38599330/f22e341107e42936a1f4ed775fdc8449fcb1d8b2.png

- Added new map: Complex, in Alpha state
-- Send us your feedback about it!
- Added Winter decorations, Candy Cane melee weapon and festive hats
- Added haptic feedback when damaging with melee weapons
- Reworked ragdolls, now they work according to weapon power and impact direction
- Minigun secondary shield breaks if suffered too much damage

New for Meta Quest versions:
- 90 FPS enabled in the Meta Quest 2 version

Changes:
- Improved and extended all animations on all weapons
- Improved Rocket projectile graphics
- Minor rendering changes due to Unreal Engine update

Optimizations:
- Made a lot of graphical optimizations for the Meta Quest 2 version

Fixes:
- Fixed false positive already friends error message
- Fixed melee weapons haptic feedback playing on wrong hand occasionally
- Fixed Railgun impact effect, now showing properly
- Fixed backup weapons list missing Neo SMG
- Fixed a bug which made bots grab too many weapons at once

Known issues, we are already working on:
- No crosshair on Judgement when joining an ongoing Instagib match and spawning with it the first time
- VR hand default pose is not correct on Meta Quest versions
- Foveated rendering isn't working on Meta Quest 1 which can lead to performance drops

notes.title: Update 13: Seated Mode and ease of access improvements
notes.notes:
Greetings, Champions!

Your comfort is top priority for us! In this update we bring you several new features to make your grappling hook experience more fluid and easy to play! So sit comfortably and let's get this match started!

New
- Added seated mode (or child mode). To activate this:
  1. Open Options/ Game tab
  2. Set your height
  3. Sit comfortably
  4. Press [Calibrate]. As a result the world will offset to your desired height.
- Gripping improvements: Gripping activates in longer range (don't have to place hand inside weapon)
- Climbing improvements: Climbing is activated also when the hand is inside the wall
- Comfort mode (tunneling vignette) can be switched on for vertical and horizontal movement separately

Changes
- Wall jumping disabled when climbing
- Crouch walk speed increased, and now can walk off ledges when crouching
- Bots got a "BOT" prefix in their name to better identify them
- Pause menu follows head more comfortably and independent from height
- Changed trace radius (aim helping) design for hitscan weapons
- New model for the teleporter exit

Fixes
- Fixed player height option display
- Fixed arrow to be visible to others too
- Fixed orientation of character animations
- Fixed flaming effect on drones in the Practice Range
- Fixed dry fire sound to only play on trigger pull
- Fixed hiding bHaptics Android UI on desktop version
- Fixed ammo count display when regripping a dropped weapon
- Added lag compensation for multiple players gripping the same object at the same time
- Added lag compensation for same player gripping multiple object at the same time
- Added lag compensation for same player gripping and grappling hook pulling objects at the same time
- Fixed crouching state going below ground

Optimizations

- Optimized characters and hands models

- Optimized ingame UI elements

This update finally brings you the long awaited private lobby functionality so from now on you will be able to play with or against your friends uninterruptedly.

How to play in a private lobby?
1. The party leader invites all other party members
2. Party leader checks "Private Party Match" before pressing Quick Play
3. Party leader selects Quick Play
This way only the members of the party will join in the match.

Note #1:
We are still working on a rejoin functionality so if someone drops out from the game, you have to start over steps 1-3. We are working hard to make this process more comfortable in the near future.

Note #2:
While we know playing against friends only is a good thing, please consider playing in public lobbies to make the game fun for everyone. Thank you.

Cyberpunk customizations
We have added some nice looking cyberpunk customizations to the game. You can find them near the beginning of the customization lists.

If you make a cool screenshot including them, post it on the internet and tag us!

The background in the image? Oh yeah, that is on of the two new maps we are working on right now.

- More weapon animations especially for the two-handed guns
- Grenade Pistol got it's well deserved new look

- Performance improvements on all weapon models and their shaders
- Standardized look for all weapons
- Hairs are differently colored now
- Headshot hit sound become different than regular hit sound

Fixes

- Fixed a bug not updating ammo UI on weapons while reloading
- Fixed a bug letting players teleport in VR
- Fixed a bug in the tutorials causing grappling hook crosshair to be visible when holding a weapon

Let's play together on Saturday
Let us invite you to join Grapple Tournament on Saturday, 5th of December between 11 AM PT and 4 PM PT for an epic session of vertical combat. At the end of the event one randomly selected lucky player will get one extra copy of the game. You can find more information here.

notes.title: Update 3: Better Grip input and Pan Hammer
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

You asked for it... the frying pan is now a melee weapon! What is more we have evaluated your answers on the community polls and changed the grip system accordingly. We hope the game will feel more comfortable this new way.

New
- Added the Pan Hammer as a selectable weapon for multiplayer. It deals less damage than the other two melee weapons and also have a different shape for collision. You can even use it as a small shield if you want to. Furthermore it deals damage for 0.5 seconds after throwing. Let's hope it does not break the game balance.
- Added a new cowboy hat

Changes
- Grip button is now the default for picking up and dropping stuff (weapons, bottles etc.)
- Grip button is now the default for climbing
- Added an extra option to enable the trigger for grabbing items ("use trigger as alternative grip")
  - Default off for Valve Index, Oculus Touch, Oculus Quest controllers
  - Default on for Vive and WMR controllers (for now)
- The arrow of the bow is still summoned by the trigger button on all platforms
- Halloween decorations removed, but don't worry winter decorations are coming soon to replace them!
- Railgun fire rate and damage slightly nerfed, recoil became a bit larger
- Optimized graphics on all levels
- Optimized player memory size
- Optimized Tunneling Vignette and Death effect

notes.title: Halloween update + online beta today
notes.notes:
Ghostly Greetings! 
While adding Halloween stuff we read through all your beta feedback and implemented a lot from what you requested: new options and performance improvements.

Next online beta event
The next online beta event is starting soon:
Saturday 24th October starting 8 AM PDT (or 11 AM EDT or 3 PM UTC) and will take approx. 8 hours.

You can stream/share/make a video about the game and we encourage you to do that!

Halloween update
New:
- Added spooky Halloween hats
- Added haunting pumpkins to the game
- Match end podium reworked and got new graphics
- Climbing now works with grip input too
- Crosshairs can be turned on/off in the options menu
- Weapon spawner rotation setting added to options. Turn it off slightly more performance gain
- Voice chat volume option added to menu
- Customization rows show item index / max numbers

Changes:
- Grappling hook cooldown is zero for now (can spam it infinitely)
- Grapple jump speed hack replaced
- Implemented a lot of audio optimizations
- Grenade pistol buffed (movement speed, mag size, damage)
- Laser beamer damage and range nerfed and auto aim became more noob friendly

Fixes:
- Fixed several colliders, glitches and level design issues on all maps
- Fixed a right menu button bug preventing inputs
- Fixed a bug when in some cases the player could interact after dying
- Fixed several voice chat issues
- Fixed a bug which caused melee weapons stay in the air
- Fixed the heartbeat sound stuck when teleporting to podium
- Fixed bots weapon rotation after target change
- Fixed several minigun sound issues
- Fixed a crash when teleporting to podium without any score
- No assist score for self

See you soon online and wish you a spooky good time!
